name: DeepTutor
one_liner: A free AI tutoring platform that builds a personalized study plan from your own documents and videos, then quizzes you over time like a human tutor tracking your progress.
buyer: An independent test-prep tutor or small online course creator who wants to offer every student a personalized, trackable study plan without hiring extra tutors.
business_use_cases: A test-prep tutor uploads a student's course materials and lets it generate a personalized learning path and spaced-repetition quizzes between paid sessions, increasing perceived value.
An online course creator self-hosts it to give paying students an always-on 'study companion' tied to the course content, boosting completion rates.
A corporate training team turns internal PDFs and training videos into self-paced, quizzed learning tracks instead of commissioning custom e-learning software.

money_ideas.idea: Self-host it and offer a branded 'AI study companion' as a premium add-on tier to an existing tutoring or course business.
Charge a setup fee to configure it with a client's own course materials and learning paths.

steal_this: Load your own course materials into it this weekend and offer a free 'AI study buddy' trial to existing students to justify launching a premium tier.
